title: Chapter 158: Flying Dragon'S First Battle
content:
Chapter 158: Flying Dragon'S First Battle

Wu Qing only made some requests for the optimization and improvement of the Zerg and Zerg Warhorse, and all the follow-up work was handed over to the Queen. There were some things on the Zerg clone that he needed to deal with personally.

When the Queen made the first big explosion, the Zerg far away in Mengzhong City could clearly sense it. Through the perspective of the Zerg stationed in Mengzhong City, the reaction of the goblin caravan could be seen.

Wu Qing knew that this big explosion would really attract the attention and concern of the surrounding powerful forces.

There is such a terrifying danger next to the bed. If we don’t figure it out, everyone will not sleep at ease.

After anticipating the actions of all parties, Wu Qing increased the number of Zerg puppies performing reconnaissance missions and strengthened the monitoring of Zerg-controlled areas.

For the scouts sent by the territories belonging to the Tengu clan, the Zerg puppies appeared directly to prevent the scouts from entering the Zerg and Alliance-controlled areas for reconnaissance.

After the battle between the two factions, the subordinate territories of the Tengu clan had a certain understanding of the Zerg, and most of them had been saved by the Zerg. When they saw the Zerg puppies coming out to stop them, they took the initiative to retreat.

They could guess that the explosion was related to the Zerg through the behavior of the Zerg puppies. It was enough for them to know this, and there was no need to investigate thoroughly.

However, on the local side, there were three teams that the Zerg puppies did not stop.

The first team was the team led by Gong Zhe. Although it was called a team, it was actually only the goblin transport vehicle that Gong Zhe was riding in. They drove along the road from Mengzhong City to Daxia Territory.

Before leaving, Gong Zhe visited the Zerg host stationed in Mengzhong City and asked about the explosion.

The Zerg host briefly explained and told Gong Zhe that this was the noise caused by the Zerg and the Alliance in recovering lost territory and fighting against the evil god army, so he didn't need to worry.

But Gong Zhe did not give up. He proposed to visit Wu Qing, saying that he had something important to discuss.

He also said that they would never affect the Zerg's combat operations and could provide certain support when necessary, as if he would not give up until he achieved his goal.

After asking Wu Qing for instructions, the Zerg host agreed to let Gong Zhe go to the area where the explosion occurred to find Wu Qing.

The reason why Wu Qing agreed, in addition to Gong Zhe's special identity, was to use the Goblin Chamber of Commerce to promote the reputation of the Zerg.

If the Zerg can be famous in the world, then the Zerg will no longer have to worry about insufficient gas resources.

…

The second team is the Tengu team, and Gou Yin is still the leader.

This time, the more than a thousand Tengu cavalrymen he led were different from the previous Tengu cavalry in terms of momentum, equipment and mounts. This was a powerful cavalry that could be compared with the bear goblin ground dragon cavalry.

What surprised Wu Qing was that the first lord he met in this world, the little fat man with a rural dog head who looked a little cute, was also in this team.

Because this dog-headed fat guy has a set of Zerg biological colonization suits, Wu Qing has paid attention to him, but this fat guy is very smart. He did not bind the biological colonization suit himself, but let a personal guard bind it.

When the Zerg needs it, they can collect information about the binder through the biological colonization suit.

The personal guard who bound the biological colonization suit, except occasionally showing the magic of the biological colonization suit, basically stayed alone in the room, and his life was also very regular. The information obtained by the Zerg from him was very limited.

From this limited information, Wu Qing knew that the dog-headed fat guy's name was Gou Bao, a little baby of the Tengu tribe who seemed to be loved by everyone.

If Gou Zheng of the Tengu tribe is a dandy, then Gou Bao is a willful little smart guy. In addition to often doing some things that people can't understand, in the eyes of the Tengu tribe, he has no big problems.

Gou Bao is Gou Yin's younger brother. It is indeed a bit willful to follow Gou Yin to the Zerg's sphere of influence under such circumstances.

Wu Qing did not stop the Tengu clan. He was just about to show the Tengu clan the strength of the Zerg clan, so as to prevent this weird Tengu clan from doing some weird things frequently.

Gou Bao followed this time, which means that the Tengu clan is still the same Tengu clan, without any change.

...

The third team is a team of a native race that Wu Qing has never seen in person. They are also a team of nearly a thousand people.

They have human bodies and snake tails, tall stature, full armor, equipped with swords, shields and bows and arrows, and are elites who have been through many battles.

They look very similar to the Naga in Wu Qing's impression. For the time being, they only have a pair of hands, not the four-armed or six-armed high-level Naga in the legend.

Wu Qing learned from the records in the book and the communication with Meng that this race, which can be translated as Naga, is a powerful race in the north close to the Tengu clan's sphere of influence.

Naga does not belong to the snake clan, but a separate race. The racial strength is very strong and occupies a large territory in the north of the Tengu clan's sphere of influence.

They didn't know where they came from, but they were probably attracted by the explosion and wanted to check it out.

Wu Qing needed to establish contact with the local powerful tribes other than the Tengu tribe, and the Naga tribe's intervention was just what he wanted.

...

Representatives of three local ethnic forces came to visit, and Wu Qing needed to receive them personally, and the reconnaissance troops sent by the evil god camp needed to be eliminated!

It happened that the new Zerg soldiers needed to be tested in actual combat, so Wu Qing sent out 5,000 flying dragons and 100 explosive mosquitoes, and the two queens and the only three-star host also followed.

This is the first time that the Zerg sent out a full-air force lineup to fight, with the main force being the flying dragons, and other arms assisting.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content below!

And the enemy lineup they have to face is also very strong.

Because the evil god camp knows the powerful strength of their forward base city, and also knows that the evil god sacrifice ceremony will be held there.

Now this completely controlled city has exploded, and there have been two consecutive explosions in a short period of time, and there is no clear news coming back, so there must be something wrong.

Knowing nothing about the specific situation, the evil god camp can only send a strong and flexible army to take the initiative to explore the situation, and by the way, provide support to the army in front as reinforcements when necessary.

This army is led by an evil god priest, with a thousand bear goblin dragon cavalry as the core, and other cavalry as the main body, totaling more than 20,000 cavalry troops.

With a one-star army as the core, and the main force is all lizard cavalry from various powerful tribes, this cavalry of more than 20,000 is enough to dominate this area.

This cavalry unit of the evil god camp ran straight to the city that had been occupied by the Zerg and the Alliance Army. After the Zerg dogs responsible for reconnaissance found them, they reported the situation and did not show up to stop them.

The limited number of Zerg dogs, facing this lineup of cavalry units, would be dying if they ran out.

In order to find out the situation as soon as possible, this cavalry unit of the evil god camp accelerated its marching speed. They were all cavalry, and the speed of accelerating the march was very fast. It would not take long for them to reach the nearby area of the city ahead.

But their speed was nothing compared to the flying dragons of the Zerg.

At the flying speed of the flying dragons, it only took them a moment to rush over from the Zerg territory.

A large group of flying creatures in the sky flew at high speed along the edge of the endless mountains. They bypassed the city occupied by the Zerg and flew towards the cavalry unit of the evil god camp that rushed over.

Wu Qing's idea was that if the new Zerg soldiers could not be exposed, they should try not to expose them first, so that the enemy could not figure out the details of the Zerg, which would be very beneficial for future wars.

This enemy not only refers to the evil god camp, but also includes all the races and territories of the native camp that are not under the control of the Zerg.

The cavalry unit, mainly composed of the bear goblin ground dragon cavalry and the bear goblin lizard cavalry, was rushing on the road, and suddenly a large group of unknown creatures flew from the horizon.

As the large group of unknown creatures flew closer and closer, their hideous and terrifying appearance could be seen clearly.

"These things are coming for us! Everyone be careful!"

The evil god priest had the most acute perception and was the first to discover the abnormality. He immediately began to bless the cavalry around him while running.

Facing the high-speed flying enemy, they can't stop now. Moving targets are always more difficult to hit than fixed targets.

As the distance between the two sides approached and the altitude decreased, facing the overwhelming Zerg flying dragons, the cavalry elites of the evil god camp also felt a sense of suffocation!

They are the first people in this world to feel the flying dragon riding on their faces!

...

Wu Qing felt the flying dragon's first battle in this world through the flying dragon's vision.

The Zerg was impressed by the metal chain hammers of the long-range weapons of the bear goblin ground dragon cavalry. Although the cavalry here was not blessed by the evil god himself, the range and power of the metal chain hammer should not be weak.

The flying dragon maintained a certain flying altitude and attacked the cavalry team running below from a long distance.

A biological bomb ejected by the flying dragon flew from the air into the moving cavalry team.

"Boom boom boom...!"

About 500 biological bombs exploded in the running cavalry team of the evil god camp!

The cavalry who were running at full speed were blown up!

"Boom boom boom...!"

After the big explosion, there was another small explosion. The micro-biological bombs flying out of the biological bombs continued to kill the surrounding targets.

In the cavalry team of the evil god camp, except for the one-star strength and well-equipped bear goblin ground dragon cavalry, which did not suffer any casualties, the other cavalry suffered a lot of damage, and the cavalry at the center of the 500 explosions suffered casualties.

Faced with this attack, the cavalry of the evil god camp did not dare to stop and ran forward desperately!

But this powerful attack was just a test of the Zerg dragon. Among the 5,000 dragons, only 500 dragons attacked once.

The attack speed of the dragon is slower than that of the hydralisk, but it is still very fast and can attack continuously. Here, only one attack is carried out to collect some battlefield data.
